culinary_recipes_schema:
CREATE TABLE "culinary_recipes" (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        family_id TEXT,
        subfamily_id TEXT,

        base_servings REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (base_servings > 0),
        serving_weight_g REAL,
        yield_quantity REAL,
        yield_unit_id TEXT,
        production_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'final_servings'
            CHECK (production_kind IN ('final_servings', 'technical_yield', 'dual')),
        default_production_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'servings'
            CHECK (default_production_mode IN ('servings', 'yield')),
        production_contract_notes TEXT,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'
            CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'reviewed', 'validated', 'archived')),

        labor_minutes REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (labor_minutes >= 0),
        labor_cost_per_hour REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (labor_cost_per_hour >= 0),
        overhead_pct REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (overhead_pct >= 0),
        target_margin_pct REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (target_margin_pct >= 0 AND target_margin_pct < 100),
        sale_price_total REAL,
        sale_price_per_serving REAL,

        process TEXT,
        service_notes TEXT,
        appcc_notes TEXT,
        notes TEXT,

        active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1)),
        created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        release_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendiente'
            CHECK (release_status IN ('pendiente', 'no_apta', 'validada')),

        FOREIGN KEY (family_id) REFERENCES technical_families(id),
        FOREIGN KEY (subfamily_id) REFERENCES technical_subfamilies(id),
        FOREIGN KEY (yield_unit_id) REFERENCES units(id)
    )
bakery_recipes_schema:
CREATE TABLE "bakery_recipes" (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        family_id TEXT,
        subfamily_id TEXT,

        base_flour_g REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000 CHECK (base_flour_g > 0),
        base_raw_weight_g REAL,
        base_pieces REAL,
        base_raw_piece_weight_g REAL,
        baked_piece_weight_g REAL,
        baking_loss_pct REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (baking_loss_pct >= 0 AND baking_loss_pct < 100),

        preferment_type TEXT,
        target_dough_temp_c REAL,
        fermentation_notes TEXT,

        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'
            CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'reviewed', 'validated', 'archived')),

        labor_minutes REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (labor_minutes >= 0),
        labor_cost_per_hour REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (labor_cost_per_hour >= 0),
        overhead_pct REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (overhead_pct >= 0),
        target_margin_pct REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (target_margin_pct >= 0 AND target_margin_pct < 100),
        sale_price_total REAL,
        sale_price_per_kg REAL,
        sale_price_per_piece REAL,

        notes TEXT,
        active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1)),
        created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        release_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendiente'
            CHECK (release_status IN ('pendiente', 'no_apta', 'validada')),
        yield_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
            CHECK (yield_status IN ('pending', 'tested', 'validated')),

        FOREIGN KEY (family_id) REFERENCES technical_families(id),
        FOREIGN KEY (subfamily_id) REFERENCES technical_subfamilies(id)
    )
